affixesDesc:
{c_mythic}Damage is dealt to your Primary Resource before Life and damage taken this way is drastically reduced.

Your Primary Resource is increased by {c_number}100%{/c} but your Maximum Life is reduced by {c_number}75%{/c}. {/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Do not allow your passions to become obsessions. Fuel the fire that burns within you, but it is madness to allow yourself to become ash to please an uncaring universe."
- Last words of Master Selig
raw_en.name: Melted Heart of Selig

affixesDesc:
{c_mythic}受到伤害时会先消耗主要资源，再扣除生命，且以此方式承受的伤害大幅降低。

你的主要资源上限提高 {c_number}100%{/c}，但生命上限降低 {c_number}75%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“不要让你的热情全都变成了执着。心中的热忱之火固然不能熄灭，但若是为了讨好一个无情的世界而将自己燃烧殆尽，那就是疯了。”
——塞利格大师的遗言
raw_zh.name: 塞利格的溶解之心

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Frenzy{/c} gains the Barrage Variant for free and can stack {c_number}2{/c} additional times. While at maximum stacks, you deal {c_random}[75 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage and your other Skills gain {c_random}[35 - 45]%[+]{/c} increased Attack Speed.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The change that overtook my brother in battle was terrifying. His eyes turned hard like diamonds, and the way he moved... it was like he was dancing to music only he could hear."
- Captain Dervin
raw_en.name: Battle Trance

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}狂乱{/c}免费获得狂乱连击变体，并且可以额外叠加 {c_number}2{/c} 次。当达到最大层数时，你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[75 - 100]%[x]{/c}，并且你的其它技能获得 {c_random}[35 - 45]%[+]{/c} 的攻击速度加成。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我兄弟在激烈的战斗中所经历的变化太可怕了。他的眼睛变得像钻石一样坚硬，他行动的方式……仿佛在随着只有他能听到的音乐起舞。” - 队长德尔文
raw_zh.name: 战斗冥思

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Swapping weapons increases the damage of {c_important}Iron Maelstrom{/c} by {c_random}[37.5 - 45.0]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}3{/c} times.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: After the warmaster Raekor freed her people, the Oxen tribe continued to wear their collars and chains to honor those who died in thralldom under the Samauren Empire.
raw_en.name: Unbroken Chain

affixesDesc: {c_unique}切换武器会使下一次施放的{c_important}钢铁漩涡{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[37.5 - 45.0]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒，最多叠加 {c_number}3{/c} 次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 尽管战争大师蕾寇已经解放了牛族，她的人民却仍不愿摘下项圈和锁链——他们希望以此来纪念那些死于萨摩雷帝国残酷奴役的同胞。
raw_zh.name: 不破束链

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}{u}Berserking's{/u}{/c} damage bonus is increased by {c_random}[85.0 - 110.0]%[+]{/c}. While not {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c}, you are always {c_important}{u}Berserk{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: An old mark of office from the town of Staalbreak, in the Dreadlands. The rage of its last owner still emanates from within.
raw_en.name: Emblem of Staalbreak

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}{u}狂暴的{/u}{/c}伤害加成提高 {c_random}[85.0 - 110.0]%[+]{/c}。在不处于{c_important}{u}健康{/u}{/c}状态时，你始终处于{c_important}{u}狂暴{/u}{/c}状态。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 恐惧之地斯塔布雷克镇的一枚古老官职印记。其前任主人的怒火仍在其中散发。
raw_zh.name: 斯塔布雷克徽记

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Casting a Skill with a Two-Handed Bludgeoning, Two-Handed Slashing, or Dual-Wielded weapon grants {c_random}[22.5 - 30.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}15{/c} seconds.

While all three bonuses are active, you gain {c_number}25%[+]{/c} Crowd Control Duration and Attack Speed.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Tried dying once. Didn't care for it." -Renit the Dark Stalker
raw_en.name: Dark Stalker's Medallion

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}使用双手钝击武器、双手劈砍武器或双持武器施放一个技能时，可以使造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[22.5 - 30.0]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}15{/c} 秒。

当以上三种加成全部激活时，你的控制持续时间和攻击速度提高 {c_number}25%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我曾死过一次。但我并不在乎。”——黑暗追猎者瑞尼特
raw_zh.name: 黑暗追猎者的勋章

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Core{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[45.0 - 60.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage, but cost {c_number}25%[x]{/c} more Fury. The damage is doubled against {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} and {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c} enemies.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"O Crane, what news do you bring from our mountain?
Long have I been away, in strange lands.
I yearn for home, for the highland snows,
Why silent, Crane? Have you no news from Arreat?"
raw_en.name: Nomad's Longing Heart

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}核心{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45.0 - 60.0]%[x]{/c}，但怒气消耗增加 {c_number}25%[x]{/c}。对{c_important}{u}受伤{/u}{/c}和{c_important}{u}健康{/u}{/c}的敌人，此伤害翻倍。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“噢，鹤啊，你从我们的高山带来了什么消息？
我已离开太久，身处异乡。
我渴望家乡，渴望高地的皑皑白雪，
为何沉默，鹤啊？难道你没有亚瑞特的消息吗？”
raw_zh.name: 游牧民的渴望之心

affixesDesc: {c_unique}When inflicting Damage Over Time, you have a chance equal to your Critical Strike Chance to increase the damage amount by {c_random}[112.5 - 135.0]%[x]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Ever watchful were the Patriarchs, as the Unclean slowly made their way out of the Dreadlands.
raw_en.name: The Open Eye of Gorgorra

affixesDesc: {c_unique}造成持续性伤害时，你有相当于你暴击几率的几率使伤害量提高 {c_random}[112.5 - 135.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 族长们始终保持着警惕，因为那些不洁之物正缓慢地从恐惧之地走出来。
raw_zh.name: 戈戈拉的睁眼

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Boulder{/c} deals {c_random}[113 - 135]%[x]{/c} increased damage and explodes when it expires.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: As the hateful mob beat on his door, he gripped the pulsing shard tightly and screamed for calm. When he opened his eyes, all that greeted him was silence and the blood-smeared ruins of his cottage.
raw_en.name: Dolmen Stone

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}滚石{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[113 - 135]%[x]{/c}，并会在持续时间结束时爆炸。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 当充满恨意的暴徒敲打他的门时，他紧紧握住不断脉动的碎片，尖声呼号着想要碎片冷静。等他睁开双眼，映入眼帘的只有一片死寂，小屋也成了一处沾满血迹的废墟。
raw_zh.name: 支石墓石

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Blood Howl{/c} is automatically cast when you Shapeshift into a Werewolf and every {c_number}4{/c} seconds while in Werewolf form. In addition, you gain {c_random}[40 - 60]%[x]{/c} bonus damage for {c_number}4{/c} seconds whenever {c_important}Blood Howl{/c} is triggered.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Túr Dúlra sat empty and the Cathedral sent forth two units. The full moon was thought to be a fair omen from the Heavens. They soon learned what else drew from its power." - History of Scosglen VI
raw_en.name: Malefic Crescent

affixesDesc: {c_unique}当你变身为狼人时会自动施放{c_important}血性狂吼{/c}，并且在狼人形态下每 {c_number}4{/c} 秒施放一次。此外，每当触发{c_important}血性狂吼{/c}时，你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 60]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}4{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “图尔·杜拉已经空无一人，圣光教闻讯，立即派出两队人马。他们原本以为，满月是上天赐予的吉兆，但很快便意识到，还有什么东西从中汲取了力量。”——《索格伦的历史》第六卷|
raw_zh.name: 凶邪新月

affixesDesc: {c_unique}You are always {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} but take {c_number}200%[x]{/c} increased damage as Burning over {c_number}8{/c} seconds. While Burning, {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} grants an additional {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The relic was fashioned for the broken-hearted and the battle-mad, for those whose rage has nowhere left to dwell." - Notes from Sister Octavia on the Burnt Knights
raw_en.name: Blood-Mad Idol

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你将始终处于{c_important}{u}狂暴{/u}{/c}状态，但会在 {c_number}8{/c} 秒内受到 {c_number}200%[x]{/c} 额外燃烧伤害。燃烧状态下，{c_important}{u}狂暴{/u}{/c}使你造成的伤害额外提高 {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “此圣物专为伤心客与嗜血狂所铸——只因其胸中怒火，已再无处容身。”——奥克塔维娅修女关于燃烧骑士的笔记
raw_zh.name: 血狂神像

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}30%{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Moo{/u}{/c} when hitting an enemy.

{c_label}Lucky Moo:{/c} Up to a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to summon a Cow that explodes for {c_random}[1,688 - 1,800]{/c} Fire damage. This damage is increased by {c_number}50%{/c} on Tuesdays. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The fever racks my body. It dances... rhythmless, endless! I fear there is but one remedy. MORE! I must hear more..." -Lester the Farmer
implict: Mondays now count as Tuesdays
raw_en.name: Bell of the Bovine

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}幸运一击: {/c} 命中敌人时最多有 {c_number}30%{/c} 几率发出{c_important}{u}哞叫{/u}{/c}。

{c_label}幸运哞击: {/c} 最多有 {c_number}50%{/c} 几率召唤一头奶牛，使其爆炸并造成 {c_random}[1,688 - 1,800]{/c} 点火焰伤害。星期二时，此伤害提高 {c_number}50%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “高烧折磨着我的身体。它不停舞动……毫无节奏，永无止境！恐怕只有一个办法能治好我。还要！我必须听到更多……”——农夫莱斯特
implict: 现在星期一也算作星期二
raw_zh.name: 魔牛之铃

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Critical Strikes deal {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c} increased damage but your Critical Strike Chance is reduced by {c_number}50%[+]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A single petal of the Mother's own blood, slowly wilting under glass.
raw_en.name: Locran's Talisman

affixesDesc: {c_unique}暴击造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c}，但你的暴击几率降低 {c_number}50%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 母亲的鲜血像一片片花瓣，在玻璃下慢慢枯萎。
raw_zh.name: 洛克兰的护身符

affixesDesc: +1 Essence per Enemy Drained by Blood Surge

{c_unique}{c_important}Blood Surge{/c} casts a mini nova on your {c_important}Minions{/c}, dealing {c_random}[61 - 128]{/c} damage. Damage is increased by {c_number}10%{/c} per target drained by the initial cast, up to {c_number}50%{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Once a sanctum for Rathma's studies, the Temple of the Deathspeaker became a proving grounds for potential leaders of his priesthood. Its halls are filled with the corpses of those who failed.
raw_en.name: Deathspeaker's Pendant

affixesDesc: +1 血涌每吸取一名敌人的鲜血时所获得的精魂。
{c_unique}{c_important}血涌{/c}会在你的{c_important}仆从{/c}位置施放一次小型新星爆发，造成 {c_random}[61 - 128]{/c} 点伤害。初始施法每吸取一个目标，该伤害就会提高 {c_number}10%{/c}，最多提高 {c_number}50%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 亡语神殿曾经是拉斯玛的研究圣地，后来成了选拔祭司领袖的试验场。神殿大厅里堆满了失败者的遗骸。
raw_zh.name: 亡语者的吊坠

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Gain {c_number}2{/c} Maximum {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u}. {c_important}{u}Blood Orbs{/c}{/u} grant {c_number}2{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u}.

Your {c_important}Blood{/c} Skills consume {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} to deal {c_random}[130 - 150]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The spark of life flows through blood, just as the spark of unlife flows through desiccated bone. There is power in both, if one knows how to use it." -Necromancer Zayl
raw_en.name: Red Blessing

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}{u}压制{/c}{/u}上限提高 {c_number}2{/c} 层。{c_important}{u}生命球{/c}{/u}提供 {c_number}2{/c} 层{c_important}{u}压制{/c}{/u}。

你的{c_important}鲜血{/c}技能会消耗 {c_number}1{/c} 层{c_important}{u}压制{/c}{/u}，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[130 - 150]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “生命的火花在血液中流淌，就像非生命的火花在干枯的骨头中流淌一样。如果懂得如何使用，这两者中都蕴含着力量。”——死灵法师扎伊尔
raw_zh.name: 猩红祝福

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Blight{/c} also shoots {c_number}4{/c} smaller piercing projectiles, each dealing {c_random}[60 - 70]%{/c} of {c_important}Blight's{/c} defiled area damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: This talisman was the life's work of Deathspeaker Jurdann. Following his premature demise, Jurdann's successor wore the amulet in tribute as they trialed against the Temple of the Deathspeaker.
raw_en.name: Ebonpiercer

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}枯萎{/c}还会发射 {c_number}4{/c} 枚小型的穿透投射物，每枚造成{c_important}枯萎{/c}污染区域伤害的 {c_random}[60 - 70]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这个护身符倾注了亡语者朱尔丹毕生的心血。朱尔丹英年早逝后，他的继承者在亡语神殿接受试炼时，佩戴了这个护身符，以示敬意。
raw_zh.name: 黑檀穿孔符

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u}, {c_important}{u}Weakened{/c}{/u}, Crowd Controlled, or Corrupted enemies are {c_important}Afflicted{/c}, taking {c_number}60%[x]{/c} increased damage from you.

{c_important}Curse{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[900 - 1,125]{/c} Shadow damage when applied to {c_important}Afflicted{/c} enemies.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Prey not on innocents, but instill fear in those who would." -Books of Kalan
raw_en.name: Will of Rathma

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}处于{c_important}{u}易伤{/c}{/u}、{c_important}{u}虚弱{/c}{/u}、被控制或腐化状态的敌人视为被{c_important}折磨{/c}，受到来自你的伤害提高 {c_number}60%[x]{/c}。

对被{c_important}折磨{/c}的敌人施加{c_important}诅咒{/c}技能时，会造成 {c_random}[900 - 1,125]{/c} 点暗影伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “不要掠食无辜者，而是要将恐惧植入那些企图这么做的人心中。”——《卡兰之书》
raw_zh.name: 拉斯玛的意志

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}{u}Arbiter{/u}{/c} form increases Aura Potency by {c_number}30%{/c} and {c_important}Wing Strike{/c} damage by {c_random}[130 - 150]%[x]{/c}{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A token wrought from the siege of Kethamar. May the keep's defenders be anointed and borne aloft on hallow'd flame.
raw_en.name: Sanctis of Kethamar

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}{u}仲裁官{/u}{/c}形态使光环强度提高 {c_number}30%{/c}，{c_important}飞翼打击{/c}的伤害提高 {c_random}[130 - 150]%[x]{/c}{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 凯萨玛围城战中锻造的信物。愿要塞的防御者受膏，并在圣焰中升腾。
raw_zh.name: 凯萨玛的圣物

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} gains all Variants and grants you {c_random}[0.80 - 1.00]%[x]{/c} increased damage and Damage Reduction for each Skill Rank it has while in {u}{c_important}Arbiter{/c}{/u} form. This bonus doubles for {c_number}30{/c} seconds after {c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} lands.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: At dawn, she sits in Judgment's stead. The host shall kneel in her radiance.
raw_en.name: Judgment of Auriel

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}正义仲裁官{/c}获得所有变体，且在{u}{c_important}仲裁官{/c}{/u}形态下，每拥有一级技能等级，使你造成的伤害和伤害减免提高 {c_random}[0.80 - 1.00]%[x]{/c}。在{c_important}正义仲裁官{/c}降落后的 {c_number}30{/c} 秒内该加成翻倍。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 黎明时分，她代行审判之位；众军将在她的光辉下跪拜。
raw_zh.name: 奥莉尔的审判

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Rain of Arrows{/c} is always {c_important}Imbued{/c} with all {c_important}Imbuements{/c} and deals {c_random}[113 - 135]%[x]{/c} increased damage to Distant enemies.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Let the great gates of Caldeum be sealed. Let its proud walls stand fiercely defended. The rest of Kehjistan may suffer this plague, but my city, and my people, will not."
- Proclamation of Hakan II
raw_en.name: Word of Hakan

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}箭雨{/c}总是同时{c_important}被灌注{/c}所有{c_important}灌注效果{/c}，并且对远距敌人造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[113 - 135]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “封锁卡尔蒂姆大门。让它引以为傲的高墙提供密不透风的防御。凯基斯坦其他地区可能会遭受这场瘟疫，但我的城市和我的人民不会。” - 哈坎二世的布告
raw_zh.name: 哈坎的口谕

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}{u}Crackling Energy's{/u}{/c} discharge rate is increased by your Attack Speed, it's damage is increased by {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}, and each hit has a {c_number}25%{/c} chance to reduce a random Cooldown by {c_number}1{/c} second.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The only thing more potent than Esadora's magic was her endless hatred of humanity. As she lay dying, the pale amulet around her neck drank in both.
raw_en.name: Esadora's Overflowing Cameo

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}{u}爆裂电花{/u}{/c}的释放频率会根据你的攻击速度提高，其伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}，并且每次命中都有 {c_number}25%{/c} 几率使随机技能的冷却时间缩短 {c_number}1{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 比艾瑟朵拉的魔法更强大的只有一种东西，那就是她对人类的无尽恨意。当她奄奄一息时，她脖子上的苍白护符将二者都吸收了。
raw_zh.name: 艾瑟朵拉的流溢浮雕

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Casting a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill has a {c_number}25%{/c} chance to summon a {c_important}Conjuration{/c} of the same element.

Each active {c_important}Conjuration{/c} grants:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_random}[2.0 - 3.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}1{/c} Mana per second
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}5%[+]{/c} Movement Speed
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}3%[+]{/c} Damage Reduction{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Winterglass refracts light and also manipulates mana - forming complex arrays of spells and enchantments. These distinct characteristics possess great power, yet the outcomes remain unpredictable.
raw_en.name: Fractured Winterglass

raw_zh.flavor: 冬镜能折射光线，还能操纵法力，形成复杂的法术和附魔阵列。这些独特的阵列具有强大的力量，但其结果却难以预料。
raw_zh.name: 破碎冬镜

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Hydra{/c} is now a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill with increased Mana cost and its attacks now explode dealing {c_random}[110 - 150]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Threefold was the sight of Oriax. He stirred the wrath of his lord Baal, and his eyes were torn and cast into the dust. Lo, the viper now crawls blind, writhing in misery." - Librarius Ex Horadrim
raw_en.name: Ophidian Iris

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}多头蛇{/c}现在是{c_important}核心{/c}技能，法力消耗增加，且其攻击会引发爆炸，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[110 - 150]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “奥里亚克斯之视力，乃三倍于常人。然而，他却因触怒了他的主子巴尔，以致双目被生生剜出，弃于尘土。看啊，这条毒蛇如今已无法视物，只能在痛苦中蜿蜒扭动了。”——《赫拉迪姆档案》
raw_zh.name: 蛇之幽瞳

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{u}{c_important}Overpower{/c}{/u} increases your {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill damage by {c_random}[20 - 25]%[x]{/c} and size, Mana cost and Cooldowns by {c_number}10%{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The greatest power is often the shortest lived.
raw_en.name: Emberfury

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{u}{c_important}压制{/c}{/u}使你的{c_important}爆焰{/c}技能伤害提高 {c_random}[20 - 25]%[x]{/c}，范围、法力消耗和冷却时间增加 {c_number}10%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 最强大的力量往往也是最短暂的。
raw_zh.name: 余烬之怒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}After you spend {c_number}275{/c} of your Primary Resource, gain {c_number}4{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. Consuming {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} increases your Critical Strikes damage by {c_random}[130 - 150]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}8{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"His name has been lost to history, but to have been exiled from a land as cursed as Hawezar, his deeds must have been truly depraved."
- Scholar's Notes
raw_en.name: Banished Lord's Talisman

affixesDesc: {c_unique}消耗 {c_number}275{/c} 点主要资源后，获得 {c_number}4{/c} 层{c_important}{u}压制{/u}{/c}。消耗{c_important}{u}压制{/u}{/c}会使你的暴击伤害提高 {c_random}[130 - 150]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 游侠, 死灵法师
raw_zh.flavor: “他的名字已经消失在历史中，但能在哈维泽这样被诅咒的地方遭到流放，他的行为定然极为邪恶。” - 学者的注释
raw_zh.name: 放逐领主的护身符

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Picking up a {c_important}{u}Storm Feather{/u}{/c} forms a firestorm around you for {c_number}12{/c} seconds dealing {c_random}[1,350 - 1,575]{/c} Fire damage every {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds.

Every {c_important}5{/c} additional {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c} you pick up intensifies the firestorm, increasing its damage by {c_number}100%[x]{/c} but not refreshing its duration. {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c} are now {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skills and the firestorm is an {c_important}Eagle{/c}, {c_important}Jaguar{/c}, and {c_important}{u}Storm Feather{/u}{/c} Skill.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Long ago, the Sunbird swallowed the sun whole. In the dark, the Spiritborn Xipil crawled to its nest and tore the sun free from the bird's gullet. Since, its throat was scorched red for its folly.
raw_en.name: Sunbird's Gorget

affixesDesc: x[12 - 20]% 火焰 伤害增倍

{c_unique}拾起{c_important}{u}风暴之羽{/u}{/c}后，你身边会出现一道持续 {c_number}12{/c} 秒的烈焰风暴，每 {c_number}0.5{/c} 秒造成 {c_random}[1,350 - 1,575]{/c} 点火焰伤害。

在此期间，每额外拾起 {c_important}5{/c} 片{c_important}{u}风暴之羽{/u}{/c}都会进一步强化烈焰风暴，使其伤害提高 {c_number}100%[x]{/c}，但不会刷新其持续时间。{c_important}{u}风暴之羽{/u}{/c}现在视作{c_important}猎豹{/c}技能，且烈焰风暴同时被视作{c_important}天鹰{/c}、{c_important}猎豹{/c}和{c_important}{u}风暴之羽{/u}{/c}技能。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 很久以前，太阳鸟曾将整个太阳吞入腹中。而在黑暗中，一个名叫希皮尔的灵巫爬进了它的巢穴，将太阳从它的喉咙里扯了出来。自此，这只鸟的身上便留下了愚行的记号——那便是它咽喉处被灼烧出的一抹烬红。
raw_zh.name: 太阳鸟颈饰

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}You deal {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.

After making an enemy {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, your next direct damage dealt to them:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Heals you for {c_number}5%{/c} of your Maximum Life
{icon:bullet,1.2} Generates {c_number}10{/c} Vigor
{icon:bullet,1.2} Removes the {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} effect{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Strike once to expose weakness, strike again to exploit it." -Teachings of Ysevete, the First Spiritborn
raw_en.name: Echo of Kwatli

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你对{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}敌人造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}。

使敌人陷入{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}状态后，你下一次对他们造成的直接伤害:
{icon:bullet,1.2} 为你恢复 {c_number}5%{/c} 生命上限
{icon:bullet,1.2} 产生 {c_number}10{/c} 点精力
{icon:bullet,1.2} 移除{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}效果{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “第一击旨在暴露破绽，第二击方能直击要害。”——初代灵巫伊塞薇忒的教诲
raw_zh.name: 库瓦特里的回音

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}The Base Spirit of a Skill cast grants:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Eagle:{/c} {c_random}[25 - 30]%[+]{/c} Movement Speed
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Gorilla:{/c} {c_random}[25 - 30]%{/c} Damage Reduction
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Jaguar:{/c} {c_random}[25 - 30]%[+]{/c} Attack Speed
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Centipede:{/c} {c_random}[2.5 - 3.0]%{/c} Life per Second

Casting a Skill of a different Base Spirit:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Swaps to the new bonus
{icon:bullet,1.2} Increases Core Stats by {c_number}100%[+]{/c} for {c_number}7{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Nahantu is everchanging. Nahantu is everlasting. When the Burning Hells become ash and soot, and when the High Heavens come crashing down, Nahantu will remain." -Excerpt from Defiance of Enkasi
raw_en.name: Protean Heart

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}施放技能的基础灵力会赋予:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}天鹰:{/c} {c_random}[25 - 30]%[+]{/c} 移动速度
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}狂猿:{/c} {c_random}[25 - 30]%{/c} 伤害减免
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}猎豹:{/c} {c_random}[25 - 30]%[+]{/c} 攻击速度
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}巨虫:{/c} {c_random}[2.5 - 3.0]%{/c} 每秒回复生命

施放不同基础灵力的技能时:
{icon:bullet,1.2} 切换至新的加成
{icon:bullet,1.2} 使核心属性提高 {c_number}100%[+]{/c}，持续 {c_number}7{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “纳罕涂瞬息万变，亦亘古长存。哪怕烈焰地狱化为劫灰，哪怕高阶天堂轰然倾颓，纳罕涂依然会屹立不倒。”——摘自《恩卡西的蔑视》
raw_zh.name: 千变之心

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your Critical Strikes cause your Poisoning on an enemy to burst, dealing {c_random}[250 - 300]%{/c} of the total Poisoning instantly to them and {c_number}10%{/c} of the burst to surrounding enemies before removing the Poisoning effect from the primary target.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "One touch is all it took. She looked into my eyes, and I understood her hunger, endless and painful. I will start with the taverns and find a strong one, with strong blood." -Jios, Sarat's Servant
raw_en.name: Widow's Web

affixesDesc: x[12 - 20]% 毒素 伤害增倍
{c_unique}你的暴击会使敌人身上的中毒效果爆发，立即对其造成总中毒伤害的 {c_random}[250 - 300]%{/c}，并对周围的敌人造成爆发伤害的 {c_number}10%{/c}，随后移除主要目标身上的中毒效果。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “仅仅一次触碰……她凝视着我的双眼。那一刻我懂了她的饥渴，那是无休无尽的痛苦深渊。我要先去酒馆找找看，必须找个骨肉强健、气血充盈的活人来。”——萨拉特的仆从吉奥斯
raw_zh.name: 寡妇织网

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[0.60 - 0.75]%[x]{/c} increased damage per Wrath you have and you take {c_random}[0.20 - 0.25]%[+]{/c} reduced damage per Dominance you have.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "In all dealings with Hells' spawn, names are both key and chain. To speak a demon's true name is to invite its presence, and seize some small dominion over it." -Master Horazon
raw_en.name: Seed of Horazon

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每拥有 1 点愤怒值，你的{c_important}恶魔学{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[0.60 - 0.75]%[x]{/c}；每拥有 1 层支配力，你受到的伤害降低 {c_random}[0.20 - 0.25]%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “在与地狱子嗣打交道时，名字既是钥匙也是锁链。呼唤一个恶魔的真名就是邀请它的到来，并获得对它的一些微小控制权。”——霍拉松大师
raw_zh.name: 霍拉松之种

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[20 - 30]%[x]{/c} increased damage for every Skill you have Empowered by {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}. Casting a {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} Empowered Skill increases you Core Stats by {c_number}5%[+]{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}50%[+]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Therefore, behold, the days come that it shall no more be called thine own body, nor thine own heart, but the heart of Moloch, for each heartbeat shall roar with the flames of Hell..." -Taphya 3:26
raw_en.name: Moloch's Beating Flame

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每个受到{c_important}{u}易爆{/u}{/c}强化的技能会使{c_important}地狱火{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[20 - 30]%[x]{/c}。施放一个受到{c_important}{u}易爆{/u}{/c}强化的技能会使你的核心属性提高 {c_number}5%[+]{/c}，持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒，最多提高 {c_number}50%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “且看，时日将至，此躯将不再为你之躯，此心亦不再为你之心，而是摩洛克之心，因那每一次心跳，皆会伴随地狱烈焰发出咆哮……”——《塔菲亚》第三章第二十六节
raw_zh.name: 摩洛克的跳动之焰

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[9.0 - 12.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage for each stack of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c}. This bonus is increased by {c_number}100%{/c} while you have {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Sleep, my child, shut fast thine eyes, 
Keep thee still until sunrise. 
Astrogha's brood will hear thy breath, 
And lull thee close to dreaming death." -Westmarch lullaby
raw_en.name: Night Terror

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每有一层{c_important}{u}暗影形态{/u}{/c}，你的{c_important}深渊{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[9.0 - 12.0]%[x]{/c}。当你处于{c_important}{u}潜行{/u}{/c}状态时，该加成效果提高 {c_number}100%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“睡吧，我的孩子，闭上你的眼睛，
安静待着直到日出。
阿斯特洛加的子嗣会听到你的呼吸，
将你哄入梦中的死亡。”——威斯特玛摇篮曲
raw_zh.name: 暗夜恐魔

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Bonuses from {c_important}Command Valloch{/c} and the {c_important}Ritualist Shard{/c} and its {c_important}Fragments{/c} have {c_number}200%[+]{/c} increased Potency. Your {c_important}Occult{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[40 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The warlock stared into the blood-stone until his eyes were scorched with dread knowledge. He felt an infernal current awaken in his veins—a plague of visions, malice, and command over the occult.
raw_en.name: The Hemat Stone

affixesDesc: {c_unique}来自{c_important}命令瓦洛克{/c}和{c_important}仪祭者碎片{/c}及其{c_important}残片{/c}的加成效果增强 {c_number}200%[+]{/c}。你的{c_important}秘术{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 60]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 术士盯着血石，直到他的双眼被可怕的知识所灼伤。他感觉到一股地狱般的潜流在他的血管中苏醒——那是幻象的瘟疫、恶意以及对超自然力量的掌控。
raw_zh.name: 赫马特之石

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Shred{/c} deals {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} more damage, and {c_important}Shred{/c} has a {c_number}33%{/c} chance to land an additional strike, up to {c_number}4{/c} times.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The nights preceding the full moon are sometimes far more dangerous than the event itself. The frenzy has begun to rise, yet the night is just dark enough to obscure a hunter from their prey's sight.
raw_en.name: Waxing Gibbous

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}利爪撕扯{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}，并且{c_important}利爪撕扯{/c}有 {c_number}33%{/c} 的几率施展一次额外攻击，至多施展 {c_number}4{/c} 次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 满月前的夜晚有时比满月之夜危险得多。疯狂与躁动开始显现，而夜色漆黑得足以让猎人消失在猎物的视线之外。
raw_zh.name: 盈月当空

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your attacks Critically Strike {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} Enemies. Killing Elites Fears and Slows nearby enemies by {c_random}[85 - 95]%{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A nightmarish amalgam of blood, bone and steel, this axe is as horrific, and as deadly, as its creator.
raw_en.name: The Butcher's Cleaver

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的攻击对{c_important}{u}受伤{/u}{/c}的敌人必定造成暴击。消灭精英会使其附近的敌人陷入恐惧并减速 {c_random}[85 - 95]%{/c}，持续 {c_number}2{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 一个用血液、骨头还有钢铁融合而成的噩梦之物，和它的创造者一样可怕且致命。
raw_zh.name: 屠夫的砍斧

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Moving grants {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}, and Maximum {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} is increased by {c_random}[2 - 4]{/c}. {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} also increases Movement Speed by {c_random}[6 - 8]%[+]{/c} per stack.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: No falsehood could endure the Thousand-Eyed King's reaver nor its countless eyes. Their gaze was bright and terrible, consumed with a world-eating hunger.
raw_en.name: Thousand-Eye Reaver

affixesDesc: {c_unique}移动时获得{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}，且{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}的最大层数提高 {c_random}[2 - 4]{/c} 层。每层{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}还会使你的移动速度提高 {c_random}[6 - 8]%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 在千眼之王的利刃与其无数魔眼面前，谎言无所遁形。其目光灼灼而可怖，满溢着吞噬世界的饥渴。
raw_zh.name: 千眼劫掠者

implict: 不可摧毁
raw_zh.name: 悔恨

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Enemies hit by {c_important}Steel Grasp{/c} take {c_random}[90 - 120]%[x]{/c} increased damage from you for {c_number}9{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Weapons wielded by the fiercest warriors often catch the eye of the Ancient spirits. If the wielder is worthy, the spirits may bless the steel with their strength." -Gerti, Oxen Tribe Forgemaster
raw_en.name: Ancients' Oath

affixesDesc: {c_unique}被{c_important}钢铁之握{/c}命中的敌人受到来自你的伤害提高 {c_random}[90 - 120]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}9{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “最骁勇的战士所挥舞的武器经常会引起先祖之灵的关注。如果武器持有者是真正的勇士，众灵会用他们的力量祝福这把武器。”——格蒂，牛族锻造大师
raw_zh.name: 先祖之誓

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Attacks have up to a {c_random}[40 - 60]%{/c} chance to explode, dealing {c_random}900{/c} Fire Damage and reducing your Cooldowns by {c_number}1{/c} second.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Before the ashes of Old Tristram had cooled, the scavengers crept in—down into the crumbling cathedral to snatch anything of value. The late Prince Aidan's greataxe would fetch a fine price indeed.
raw_en.name: Messerschmidt's Reaver

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_label}幸运一击:{/c} 攻击最多有 {c_random}[40 - 60]%{/c} 几率引发爆炸，造成 {c_random}900{/c} 点火焰伤害，并使你的冷却时间缩短 {c_number}1{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 旧崔斯特姆的余烬尚未冷却，拾荒者便已悄然潜入。他们深入摇摇欲坠的大教堂，搜刮一切值钱的东西。已故的艾丹王子所用的巨斧，想必能卖出一笔好价钱。
raw_zh.name: 梅塞施密特的劫掠者

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal [2,200 - 5,400] Poisoning Damage over 10 seconds
implict: +15.0% Chance for an extra item from the Purveyor of Curiosities
raw_en.name: Edge

raw_zh.name: 无限

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Casting an {c_important}Aura{/c} Skill triggers a {c_important}Consecration{/c} beneath you. 

You gain {c_random}[160 - 200]%{/c} {c_important}Aura{/c} Potency while standing in {c_important}Consecration{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Heat struck my face and I thought the sun had risen early. Each swing of the hammer cleaved through the hordes, and every man shouted, wild with awe: The night ends!" - Survivor, Battle of Westmarch
raw_en.name: Sundered Night

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}施放{c_important}光环{/c}技能时，会在你的脚下触发一次{c_important}奉献{/c}。

当站在{c_important}奉献{/c}区域内时，你获得 {c_random}[160 - 200]%{/c} {c_important}光环{/c}强度。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “热浪扑面而来，我以为是太阳提前升起。每一次战锤挥落都劈开敌群，战士们发出混杂着狂怒与敬畏的嘶吼：长夜终尽！”——威斯特玛之战幸存者
raw_zh.name: 撕裂长夜

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[0.80 - 1.00]%[x]{/c} increased damage per Wrath you have but you lose {c_number}10%{/c} Wrath per second. Every {c_number}50{/c} Wrath gained beyond your Maximum generates {c_number}1{/c} Dominance.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "I am the voice of vengeance unsated. Brandish me and my enmity shall walk with thine. Thy grief is thy tithe. My dirge, the dread reward."
raw_en.name: Dirge of Odium

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每拥有 1 点愤怒值，你的{c_important}基础{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[0.80 - 1.00]%[x]{/c}，但每秒会失去 {c_number}10%{/c} 愤怒值。每获得 {c_number}50{/c} 点超出上限的愤怒，产生 {c_number}1{/c} 层支配力。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我即是那永难平息的复仇之声。挥舞我吧，我的怨毒将与你如影随形。你的悲恸便是我索取的什一税，而我奏响的挽歌，便是那骇人的馈赠。”
raw_zh.name: 憎恶的哀怨挽歌

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Ground Stomp's{/c} damage is increased by {c_random}[20.0 - 25.0]%[x]{/c} plus an additional amount based on the distance traveled since the last casted {c_important}Ground Stomp's{/c}, up to {c_random}[80.0 - 100.0]%[x]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "While many Barbarians remained in the Dreadlands, small groups from the Oxen, Crane, and Bear tribes instead chose to search the land for a new home." -A History of the Children of Bul-Kathos
raw_en.name: 100,000 Steps

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}大地践踏{/c}的伤害提高 {c_random}[20.0 - 25.0]%[x]{/c}，并根据自上次施放{c_important}大地践踏{/c}以来移动的距离额外提高伤害，最高可达 {c_random}[80.0 - 100.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “虽然许多野蛮人留在了恐惧之地，但来自牛族、鹤族和熊族部落的小部分人反而选择在这片土地上寻找一个新的家园。” ——布尔凯索之子的历史
raw_zh.name: 十万加行

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill while at Maximum Fury causes your Fury to increasingly Drain until you run out, during which your {c_important}Basic{/c} skills now cleave dealing {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
Break their bones beneath your weight, 
Fell their walls and breach their gate. 
In his halls we'll boast and sing, 
And praise our honored mountain king!
raw_en.name: Hooves of the Mountain God

affixesDesc: {c_unique}在怒气满额时施放{c_important}基础{/c}技能，导致你的怒气持续流失直到耗尽，在此期间，你的{c_important}基础{/c}技能现在会顺劈，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
以君之威，碎敌骨骸，
摧其壁垒，破其城寨。
君之殿内，欢歌喝彩，
颂我山君，千秋万代！
raw_zh.name: 山神的巨蹄

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Poison Creeper{/c} gains the Germinate Variant for free and deals {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Ciódan was known to be a true friend of the Deep Forest. In gratitude, he was protected fiercely by nature itself.
raw_en.name: Greenwalker's Oath

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}剧毒藤蔓{/c}免费获得生根发芽变体，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 众所周知，西奥丹是深林的真挚朋友。作为回报，他受到了大自然本身的严密保护。
raw_zh.name: 绿行者之誓

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Rabies{/c} spreads {c_number}100%{/c} faster and deals {c_number}10%[x]{/c} bonus damage (max {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c}) each time it spreads. Bosses take maximum bonus damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Do not seek comfort in the shapes of the moon, beastwalker. Its pallid light awakens a yawning hunger. Call the beast, but do not tarry. Lest you never return to your own skin.
raw_en.name: Wildheart Hunger

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}狂犬撕咬{/c}的传播速度提高 {c_number}100%{/c}，且每次传播都会使造成的伤害提高 {c_number}10%[x]{/c}（最多提高 {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c}）。对首领造成的伤害始终获得最高加成。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 不要向圆月寻求安慰，兽行者。苍白的月光会唤醒饥饿的渴望。召唤野兽，但不要耽搁。以免落得皮开肉绽的下场。
raw_zh.name: 野性之心的饥饿

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} gains the Earthen Shrapnel Variant for free and deals {c_random}[150 - 200]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Once worn by the lost druids who sang the sandy gales to sleep. When their line was broken, the desert rose in mourning, staining the sky blood-red as Kehjistan choked beneath fifty years of dust.
raw_en.name: Khamsin Steppewalkers

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}大地壁垒{/c}免费获得岩石弹片变体，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[150 - 200]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 曾为能吟唱沙暴入睡的失落德鲁伊所穿着。在其血脉断绝之时，沙漠在哀悼中怒放，将天空染成血红，凯基斯坦因此被笼罩在沙尘之下长达五十载。
raw_zh.name: 热风步行靴

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}You are permanently {u}{c_important}Unhindered{/c}{/u} and leave behind a trail of frost that {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} enemies. 

Your {u}{c_important}Chill{/c}{/u} effects cause enemies to take {c_random}[10 - 15]%[x]{/c} increased damage from you.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Remorseful devotees of the Cathedral of Light must undertake a grueling pilgrimage, journeying across the frigid glacier known as the Serac Rapture. Only then may their gravest sins be forgiven.
raw_en.name: Penitent Greaves

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你永久获得{u}{c_important}无束{/c}{/u}状态，并在身后留下一道会使敌人{c_important}{u}冻伤{/u}{/c}的冰霜轨迹。

你的{u}{c_important}冻伤{/c}{/u}效果会使敌人受到来自你的伤害提高 {c_random}[10 - 15]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 忏悔的圣光大教堂信徒必须进行一场艰苦的朝圣之旅，穿越被称为升天冰塔的寒冷冰川。只有这样，他们最深重的罪孽才能得到宽恕。
raw_zh.name: 悔罪护胫

affixesDesc: Attacks Reduce Evade's Cooldown by [1.0 - 1.2] Seconds
{c_unique}Each enemy you Evade through reduces your active Ultimate Cooldown by {c_random}[3.0 - 4.0]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}10{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Considered a failure by their creator, it wasn't until the assassination of an "untouchable" Caldeum noble that these boots' true power was understood."
- Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Flickerstep

affixesDesc: 攻击使闪避的冷却时间缩短 [1.0 - 1.2] 秒
{c_unique}你每用闪避穿过一名敌人，激活的终极技能的冷却时间都会缩短 {c_random}[3.0 - 4.0]{/c} 秒，最多缩短 {c_number}10{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “创造这些靴子的人认为它们是失败品。直到一位‘贵不可及的’卡尔蒂姆贵族被刺杀后, 人们才明白这些靴子的真正力量。” - 巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 摇曳之步

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting a Skill has a {c_random}[40 - 60]%{/c} chance to trigger a Non-{c_important}Mobility{/c}, Non-{c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill that is currently on Cooldown. Can only occur once every {c_number}8{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: These greaves are imbued with the divine blessing of Yen, the Veradani goddess of restoration. They bestow the wearer a revitalizing strength that enhances their own.
raw_en.name: Yen's Blessing

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放一个技能有 {c_random}[40 - 60]%{/c} 几率触发一个正在冷却中的非{c_important}机动{/c}、非{c_important}终极{/c}技能。该效果每 {c_number}8{/c} 秒只能生效一次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 护胫灌注着梵罗达尼治疗女神——延的神圣祝福。它们能使穿着者恢复活力，增强他们自身的力量。
raw_zh.name: 延的祝福

affixesDesc: {c_unique}When you cast a Skill with a Cooldown, you explode, dealing {c_random}[450 - 525]{/c} Fire damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Tread carefully on the plains of Hell, for each step sunders the soul and shatters the mind.
raw_en.name: Rakanoth's Wake

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放有冷却时间的技能时，你会爆炸，造成 {c_random}[450 - 525]{/c} 点火焰伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 在地狱的茫茫焦土上要小心前进，因为每走一步，都会撕裂灵魂、粉碎心智。
raw_zh.name: 拉卡诺斯的尾迹

affixesDesc: +[30.9 - 44.4]% Chance for Sever to Deal Double Damage
{c_unique}{c_important}Sever{/c} leaves behind {c_important}Desecrated Ground{/c} that deals {c_random}[300 - 1,200]{/c} Corrupting damage over {c_number}2{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The massive door to my family's crypt, which had taken a dozen men to close, was thrown open. Had I known the horrors to come I never would have set foot inside!" -The Ebon Pages, Canto I, Verse VII
raw_en.name: Greaves of the Empty Tomb

affixesDesc: +[30.9 - 44.4]% 几率使挥斩造成双倍伤害
{c_unique}{c_important}挥斩{/c}会留下一片{c_important}亵渎之地{/c}，在 {c_number}2{/c} 秒内对其中的敌人造成 {c_random}[300 - 1,200]{/c} 点腐化伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “通往我们家族墓穴的大门，需要十几个人才能关得上，而现在那门却敞开着。我要是知道会有这么恐怖的事情发生，那我死也不会踏进半步！”——《黑檀书页》第一篇第七节
raw_zh.name: 鬼墓空棺护胫

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Bone Prison{/c} traps a larger area and fires {c_random}[30 - 35]{/c} {c_important}Bone Splinters{/c} at enemies trapped within. 

Your Maximum Essence is increased by {c_number}2{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds each time these {c_important}Bone Splinters{/c} hit an enemy.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Essence flows endlessly, shifting between vessels. It is through Trag'Oul, keeper of all known and unknown, that we serve as custodians, directing essence to travel new paths." -Mendeln ul-Diomed
raw_en.name: Path of Trag'Oul

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}骨牢{/c}困住的区域变得更大，并且会向困在其中的敌人发射 {c_random}[30 - 35]{/c} 枚{c_important}白骨碎片{/c}。

每次这些{c_important}白骨碎片{/c}命中敌人，你的精魂上限都会提高 {c_number}2{/c} 点，持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “精魂不断流动，在各容器之间此消彼长。正是通过塔格奥——知识与奥秘的守护者——我们才得以作为监管人，指引精魂流向新的道途。”——孟德恩·乌·狄俄墨得
raw_zh.name: 塔格奥的道途

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Blood Mist{/c} casts {c_important}Corpse Explosion{/c} on surrounding Corpses. When {c_important}Blood Mist{/c} detonates a Corpse, its Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}1{/c} second and you gain {c_random}[50 - 60]%[+]{/c} increased Movement Speed for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "These Priests of Rathma are quite peculiar. Is it possible to dabble in the forbidden yet uphold Balance? Too often, the power of such magic leads to corruption." –The Writings of Abd al-Hazir
raw_en.name: Blood Wake

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}血雾{/c}会在周围的亡骸上施放{c_important}邪爆{/c}。当{c_important}血雾{/c}引爆一具亡骸时，其冷却时间缩短 {c_number}1{/c} 秒，并且你的移动速度提高 {c_random}[50 - 60]%[+]{/c}，持续 {c_number}3{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “这些拉斯玛的祭司相当奇特。有没有可能在涉足禁忌的同时维持平衡呢？通常情况下，这种法术的力量往往会导致腐化。”——阿卜杜·哈兹尔的著作
raw_zh.name: 鲜血尾迹

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Advance{/c} deals {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c} increased damage, gains {c_number}3{/c} Skill Ranks, and travels twice as far.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "...and though he marched through shadow and storm, his flame never waned. On the thirtieth day, he arrived to spread the word of Akarat's passing." - Scrolls of Yaerius
raw_en.name: March of the Stalwart Soul

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}晋升{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c}，获得 {c_number}3{/c} 技能级别且移动距离翻倍。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “……尽管他行过暗影与风暴，他的火焰也从未熄灭。在第三十天，他抵达了，传播阿卡拉特逝去的消息。”——《亚瑞斯卷轴》
raw_zh.name: 坚定灵魂的行军

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Evading{/c} leaves behind {c_important}Caltrops{/c}. {c_important}Caltrops{/c} gain {c_number}50%[+]{/c} increased Size and deal {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"My feet do not ache—there is no greater pain than stopping.
Into the Abyss I go. I will find her. I will bring her home. 
Hell cannot keep me from her, but it is welcome to try."
- Unknown
raw_en.name: Desperate March

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}闪避{/c}会在身后留下{c_important}铁蒺藜{/c}。{c_important}铁蒺藜{/c}的范围扩大 {c_number}50%[+]{/c}，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“我的双脚并不疼痛——没有比停下脚步更剧烈的痛苦了。
我要步入深渊。我会找到她。我会带她回家。
地狱无法将她从我身边夺走，但它大可以试试。”
——佚名
raw_zh.name: 绝命行军

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}When you Cast a non-Channeled {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill, it Consumes all of your Energy and deals {c_random}[0.60 - 0.75]%[x]{/c} increased damage per Energy Consumed.

Using a Cooldown restores {c_number}25{/c} Energy.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Genai grew proud and fond of boasting of her hunting prowess. She claimed she was fast enough to catch even the spirit Leraye, who cursed her for such an insult."
- Fable of Genai's Twenty Trials
raw_en.name: Beastfall Boots

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}当施放非引导类{c_important}终极{/c}技能时，它会消耗你所有的能量，并且每消耗一点能量，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[0.60 - 0.75]%[x]{/c}。

使用带有冷却时间的技能可恢复 {c_number}25{/c} 点能量。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“盖娜变得骄傲自满，整日吹嘘自己的狩猎本领，声称自己的速度之快，就连勒莱耶之灵都能抓住。于是，勒莱耶便对她降下了诅咒，以惩治这番不敬之言。”
——《盖娜的二十道试炼》
raw_zh.name: 屠兽之靴

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Mobility{/c} Skills are always {c_important}Shadow Imbued{/c} with {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased potency. 

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damaging an Elite or Boss with a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill has up to a {c_random}[45 - 60]%{/c} chance to instantly trigger a free {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} explosion.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The Viz-Jaq'taar descended on the mages indiscriminately and silently as a plague. The wise took flight, whilst the foolish fortified their dwellings as if walls or wards protected from shadow.
raw_en.name: Assassin's Stride

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}机动{/c}技能必定{c_important}被暗影灌注{/c}，且强度效果提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}。

{c_label}幸运一击: {/c}使用{c_important}机动{/c}技能对精英或首领造成伤害时，最多有 {c_random}[45 - 60]%{/c} 几率立即触发一次免费{c_important}暗影灌注{/c}爆炸。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 维兹贾塔如同瘟疫一般，悄无声息地出现在法师面前，对他们发起了毫无差别的攻击。智者纷纷逃离，而愚者则选择加固住所，以为坚壁和结界能够保护他们免受暗影侵袭。
raw_zh.name: 刺客的阔步靴

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your Critical Strike Chance is increased by {c_random}[20 - 40]%{/c} of your Movement Speed bonus.

Current Bonus: {c_number}-[40.0 - 20.0]%{/c}{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"While scholars have proven these boots were not created by Esu herself, it is noteworthy that they have been passed down since the formation of the Mage Clans."
- Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Esu's Heirloom

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的暴击几率提高，数值相当于你的移动速度加成的 {c_random}[20 - 40]%{/c}。

当前加成: {c_number}-[40.0 - 20.0]%{/c}{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “虽然学者们已经证明这双靴子不是艾苏的作品，但值得一提的是，这双靴子自法师部族形成时起，就一直被代代传承。” - 巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 艾苏的传家宝

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Ice Armor{/c} gains the Permafrost Variant for free and has {c_random}[20 - 25]%{/c} increased potency.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Legend says those who survive the Hall of Mirrors emerge forever changed, able to enchant objects with an innate cold.
raw_en.name: Gift of Frost

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}寒冰甲{/c}免费获得永冻之霜变体，并且强度提高 {c_random}[20 - 25]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 传说那些在镜像大厅中幸存下来的人会发生永久性的改变，能够将一种与生俱来的寒意附魔在物体上。
raw_zh.name: 冰霜之赐

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}You invoke up to {c_random}[8 - 12]{/c} base {c_important}Core{/c} Skills from your primary Spirit Hall split across every {c_number}50{/c} meters you move.

While {c_important}Ravager{/c} is active, Casting {c_important}Core{/c} Skills instantly dashes you to your target.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The path remembers the feet that tread it often. It bends its course to those who never stray." - Tarka, the Emissary
raw_en.name: Path of the Emissary

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你每移动 {c_number}50{/c} 米，就会从你主要的众灵之厅调用最多 {c_random}[8 - 12]{/c} 个基础{c_important}核心{/c}技能。

当{c_important}劫掠者{/c}激活期间，施放{c_important}核心{/c}技能会使你立即向你的目标冲刺。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “道路会铭记常行者的足迹，并为从不偏离之人蜿蜒迁就。”——“特使”塔卡
raw_zh.name: 特使之路

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Evade{/c} is now {c_important}Soar{/c}.

{c_important}Soar{/c} deals {c_random}[125 - 150]%[x]{/c} increased damage and triggers {c_important}Vortex{/c} at its landing location{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Sky Spirits weave the winds. Thunder is their laughter and auroras their crowns. Those they bless learn to scorn the earth, for from above, it is but a distant memory." - Lintel VII
raw_en.name: Scorn of the Earth

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}闪避{/c}现在变为{c_important}飞空{/c}。

{c_important}飞空{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[125 - 150]%[x]{/c}，并在着陆位置触发{c_important}漩涡{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “风是由天空之灵织就的。雷电是他们的欢笑，极光是他们的冠冕。而那些得蒙其祝福的人也渐渐开始蔑视大地。毕竟，从空中俯瞰，下面的世界不过是一段遥远的记忆。”——林特尔七世
raw_zh.name: 大地的蔑视

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Evade{/c} is now {c_important}Nether Step{/c} and your {c_important}Evade{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_random}[0.60 - 1.00]{/c} seconds as you lose or consume {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} stacks.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Step onward, and the living realm shall dim behind thee as the Black Road uncoils, eternal and cold. Even death shall fail to follow thee there.
raw_en.name: Footfalls of the Waning World

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}闪避{/c}变为{c_important}幽冥行走{/c}，且随着你失去或消耗{c_important}{u}暗影形态{/u}{/c}层数，你的{c_important}闪避{/c}冷却时间缩短 {c_random}[0.60 - 1.00]{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 向前一步，生者的界域将在你身后逐渐黯淡，而永恒寒冷的黑路正在铺展。哪怕是死亡，也无法追随你至此。
raw_zh.name: 衰亡世界的足音

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Abodian{/c} deals {c_random}[200 - 280]%[x]{/c} increased damage. {c_important}Command Abodian{/c} periodically triggers your Non-{c_important}Archfiend Hellfire{/c} Skills while moving and its Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "As loyal as we may think they might be, they are still demons. And they will take any chance they can to destroy us." -Book of Adria
raw_en.name: Hellhound's Sabatons

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}阿博迪安{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[200 - 280]%[x]{/c}。{c_important}命令阿博迪安{/c}在移动时会周期性触发你的非{c_important}高等恶魔地狱火{/c}技能，且其冷却时间缩短 {c_number}50%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “哪怕我们天真地以为它们已然归顺，它们也依然是恶魔。只要一逮到机会，它们就会毫不犹豫地将我们撕碎。”——《艾德莉亚之书》
raw_zh.name: 地狱犬马靴

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Every consecutive Cast of {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} increases the amount of arrows it fires by {c_number}2{/c}, up to {c_number}6{/c}. {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} deals {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Genai took up her bow and aimed at the sun itself. The light burned her eyes, but her arrow flew true. Wounded, the sun hid, and brought forth the first night."
- Fable of the Great Sky-Hunt
raw_en.name: Skyhunter

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}快速射击{/c}连续施放每次都会增加发射的箭矢数量，每次增加 {c_number}2{/c} 支，最多增加 {c_number}6{/c} 支。{c_important}快速射击{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “盖娜拿起她的弓，瞄准了太阳。阳光灼伤了她的双眼，但箭矢依然没有落空。受伤的太阳隐藏了起来，从而带来了第一个夜晚。” - 《猎天传奇》
raw_zh.name: 猎天者

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Arrow Storms{/c} last {c_number}2{/c} seconds shorter, deal {c_random}[120 - 180]%[x]{/c} increased damage, and, when created, have a {c_number}50%{/c} chance  to create an additional {c_important}Arrow Storm{/c} on a nearby target.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Tell us, Oracle Queen, of our great Amazon Sister, who wandered far from her home into the Heart of Terror." -Ode to the Warmatron
raw_en.name: Cassia's Grace

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}箭镞风暴{/c}持续时间缩短 {c_number}2{/c} 秒，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120 - 180]%[x]{/c}，并且在生成时，有 {c_number}50%{/c} 几率在附近目标身上生成一个额外的{c_important}箭镞风暴{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “告诉我们，神谕者女王，关于我们那位伟大的亚马逊姐妹的事迹，她远离家乡，流浪至恐惧的心脏。”——《战争女王颂》
raw_zh.name: 卡西娅的恩典

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Hits of {c_important}Barrage{/c} have a {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} chance to deal triple damage and Knock Down enemies.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"There have been numerous world-shaping conflicts throughout history. This bow has been found on the battlefield of every one, and always in the hands of the victors."
- Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Windforce

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}乱射{/c}击中敌人时，有 {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} 几率造成三倍伤害并击倒敌人。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “历史上发生过无数次影响世界的冲突。每一场这样的冲突中都会出现这把弓的身影，并且总会在胜利者的手中。” - 巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 风之力

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Penetrating Shot{/c} bounces off walls and deals {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c} more damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Scholars have been unable to decipher the runes carved into this bow, however all agree they are related to its uncanny ability to bend arrows towards their targets."
- Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Eaglehorn

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}穿透射击{/c}可以在墙壁上弹射，且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “学者们一直未能破译这把弓上刻着的符文，不过大家都认同一点，它们应该就是这把弓能让箭矢拐弯射向目标的原因。” - 巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 鹰之号角

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal [2,200 - 5,400] Poisoning Damage over 10 seconds
implict: +15.0% Chance for an extra item from the Purveyor of Curiosities
raw_en.name: Edge

affixesDesc: 幸运一击: 最多有 40% 几率在 10 秒内造成 [2,200 - 5,400] 点中毒伤害
implict: +15.0% 几率从珍品商处额外获得一件物品
raw_zh.name: 锐锋

raw_zh.name: 无限

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal +[3,000 - 4,800] Lightning Damage
raw_en.name: Zephyr

affixesDesc: 幸运一击：最多有 40% 几率造成 +[3,000 - 4,800] 点闪电伤害
raw_zh.name: 和风

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}When you would be dealt fatal damage, instead you Heal to full Life, gain a Barrier for {c_number}100%{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}3{/c} seconds, and Knock Back Close enemies. This power is disabled once used until you return to town.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Auriel alone saw past Lucion's guise. With Al'maiesh aloft, she smote the vile prince. Hatred's seed feigned death and waited, loath to enter the Abyss again." - The Great Conflict, Tome I
raw_en.name: Shroud of False Death

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}受到致命伤害时，改为恢复全部生命，获得相当于生命上限 {c_number}100%{/c} 的屏障，持续 {c_number}3{/c} 秒，并击退近距敌人。此能力触发后会被禁用，直至你返回城镇。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “只有奥莉尔看穿了路西昂的伪装。于是，她高高扬起奥尔麦什，给了这个邪恶的王子重重一击。不过，这位憎恨之王的子嗣却选择了装死。他等待着，逡巡着，不愿再次进入冥渊。”——《大冲突》卷一
raw_zh.name: 虚假死亡之衣

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}Gain {c_number}20%{/c} Damage Reduction. While at full Life, your Skills unleash a divine barrage dealing {c_number}450{/c} damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Thus Tyrael, a perfect aspect of Justice, came to be. None were more vehement against the forces of hell. All demonic entities learned to shudder at Justice's might." 
-The Books of Jarl, Volume I
implict: Indestructible
raw_en.name: Tyrael's Might

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}获得 {c_number}20%{/c} 伤害减免。生命值全满时，你的技能会释放神圣弹幕，造成 {c_number}450{/c} 点伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“于是，正义的完美化身——泰瑞尔诞生了。没有人能比他更勇猛地对抗地狱之力。吸取教训后，所有恶魔都在正义之力面前颤抖。”
——王公之书，第一卷
implict: 不可摧毁
raw_zh.name: 泰瑞尔之力

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Inflicting Damage Over Time on an enemy has up to a {c_random}[45 - 60]%{/c} chance to reduce the Cooldowns of your Skills by {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Harrogath, the final bastion of resistance against Baal's assault on Mt. Arreat was destroyed along with the Worldstone. The survivors never forgave the betrayal that led to the loss of their home.
raw_en.name: Rage of Harrogath

affixesDesc: {c_unique}对敌人造成持续性伤害时，最多有 {c_random}[45 - 60]%{/c} 几率使你的技能冷却时间缩短 {c_number}0.5{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 哈洛加斯，抵抗巴尔进攻亚瑞特山的最后堡垒，与世界之石一道崩毁了。幸存者永远不会原谅导致他们失去家园的背叛行为。
raw_zh.name: 哈洛加斯之怒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} on an {c_important}Earthquake{/c} explodes for their total damage and are consumed, and also causes your {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} to deal {c_random}[60.00 - 80.00]%[x]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "What you feel is the Ancients high on the mountain, my son. When they stomp their feet, the earth trembles! But fear not—it's our enemies they mean to warn." -Chieftess Naarah
raw_en.name: Mantle of Mountain's Fury

affixesDesc: {c_unique}在{c_important}撼地重击{/c}上施放{c_important}先祖之锤{/c}会使其爆炸，造成等同于其总伤害的伤害并将其消耗，同时使你的{c_important}先祖之锤{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60.00 - 80.00]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我的孩子，和你产生共鸣的是高山之上的先祖。他们跺一跺脚，大地便要颤上一颤！不过，无需害怕——他们只是想警告敌人。”——女酋长娜拉
raw_zh.name: 山峦之怒斗篷

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} deals {c_random}[22.5 - 30.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage on consecutive hits to the same target. This stacks up to {c_number}3{/c} times.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Though he was stuck with a dozen arrows, the barbarian charged Rakkis' lines and swept away any who stood before him. The more he bled, the more ferocious were his blows." -The Chronicles of Rakkis
raw_en.name: The Relentless Heart

affixesDesc: {c_unique}连续使用{c_important}先祖之锤{/c}命中同一个目标时，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[22.5 - 30.0]%[x]{/c}。最多叠加 {c_number}3{/c} 次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “尽管身插十余支利箭，这名野蛮人依然冲入了拉基斯的阵线，将所有胆敢阻拦之人尽数横扫。他流的血越多，挥出的重击便越发凶悍。”——《拉基斯编年史》
raw_zh.name: 无情核心

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Lacerate{/c} has no Cooldown, costs {c_number}100{/c} Spirit to cast and deals {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} bonus damage but no longer grants {c_important}{u}Immunity{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Lacerate{/c} is also a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"He was not a victim of the curse. He sought it out. As his muscles grew and body changed from man to beast, his laughter never ceased." 
– Tale of the Mad Nobleman
raw_en.name: Mad Wolf's Glee

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}疯狂撕咬{/c}没有冷却时间，施放时消耗 {c_number}100{/c} 点灵力，并且额外造成 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} 伤害，但不再提供{c_important}{u}免疫{/u}{/c}。

{c_important}疯狂撕咬{/c}也被视为{c_important}核心{/c}技能。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“他并非诅咒的受害者。他是在渴求它。当他的肌肉不断膨胀，身躯由人堕入野兽时，他的狂笑从未停歇。”
——疯狂贵族的故事
raw_zh.name: 疯狼的狂喜

affixesDesc: {c_unique}For {c_number}2{/c} seconds after Casting {c_important}Trample{/c}, you may Cast {c_important}Trample{/c} again without incurring the Cooldown. {c_important}Trample{/c} additionally deals {c_random}[150 - 200]%[x]{/c} bonus damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: When the Days of Ash began, the great druid Nafain reminded his disciples that nothing, not even the loss of their humanity, was too great a sacrifice to protect Túr Dúlra from Astaroth's flames.
raw_en.name: Insatiable Fury

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}践踏{/c}后的 {c_number}2{/c} 秒内，你可以再次施放{c_important}践踏{/c}而不会触发冷却时间。{c_important}践踏{/c}还会额外造成 {c_random}[150 - 200]%[x]{/c} 额外伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “灰烬之日”到来时，伟大的德鲁伊纳菲恩提醒他的门徒们说，为了保护图尔·杜拉不受阿斯塔洛斯的烈焰伤害，没有什么是不能牺牲的，哪怕他们的人性。
raw_zh.name: 无餍之怒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}When you hit at least {c_number}1{/c} enemy with {c_important}Maul{/c}, increase its Attack Speed by {c_number}3%[+]{/c} and damage by {c_random}[20 - 25]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}5{/c} times.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "You kept us from harm. Forever will you hold a place of honor. We will always look up to you...brother." -Grey of Clan Skeld
raw_en.name: Heart of Azgar

affixesDesc: {c_unique}当你使用{c_important}重殴{/c}击中至少 {c_number}1{/c} 个敌人时，使其攻击速度提升 {c_number}3%[+]{/c}，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[20 - 25]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒，最多叠加 {c_number}5{/c} 次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “你保护了我们免受伤害。你将永远享有荣誉之位。我们将永远仰望你……兄弟。”——斯科尔德部族的格雷
raw_zh.name: 阿兹加尔之心

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Thorns has a {c_number}30%{/c} chance to deal {c_random}[200 - 250]%[x]{/c} increased damage. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: Crafted by the cannibal Armoda, each piece of this interlocking armor has been sharpened into a knife's edge. Even a century after death, the plate remained on her corpse, unable to be removed safely.
raw_en.name: Razorplate

affixesDesc: {c_unique}荆棘有 {c_number}30%{/c} 几率造成 {c_random}[200 - 250]%[x]{/c} 的额外伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这件连环相扣的护甲是由食人族的阿摩达制作的，每一块部件都被打磨成了刀刃的形状。甚至在她死后的一百年，这套板甲仍然套在她的遗骸上，无法被安全地取下。
raw_zh.name: 剃刀甲

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your Healing Potions grant a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}100%{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}1{/c} second.

You gain {c_random}[25 - 30]%{/c} Damage Reduction while you have a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} and may drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"To create such an artifact would require an impossible mastery over alchemy, transmutation and the subtle magics of the soul. By all rights, it should not exist, yet it does."
- Artisan Callas
raw_en.name: Soulbrand

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的治疗药水会提供一个数值相当于生命上限 {c_number}100%{/c} 的{c_important}{u}屏障{/u}{/c}，持续 {c_number}1{/c} 秒。

拥有{c_important}{u}屏障{/u}{/c}时，你将获得 {c_random}[25 - 30]%{/c} 伤害减免，并可在生命值全满时饮用治疗药水。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “要创造这样的神器, 需要在炼金术、塑形术和灵魂的微妙魔法方面拥有非凡的造诣。按道理来说它不该存在, 但它的确存在。” - 匠师卡拉斯
raw_zh.name: 灵魂烙印

affixesDesc: {c_unique}While not taking damage, you take up to {c_number}50%{/c} more damage and deal up to {c_random}[35 - 50]%[x]{/c} more damage. This bonus is reset upon losing Life.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: It looks like the blouse of a street urchin with a crude stone pendant. But the inside is lined with hidden pockets and sinister sheathes. And on the back of the pendant? A old runic word: "Kantwirt."
raw_en.name: Squirt's Blouse

affixesDesc: {c_unique}未受到伤害时，你受到的伤害最多提高 {c_number}50%{/c}，造成的伤害最多提高 {c_random}[35 - 50]%[x]{/c}。损失生命后，该加成会重置。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 看着像流浪儿的罩衫，挂着块粗石坠子。可里子缝满暗袋和阴森的刀鞘。坠子背面呢？刻着一个古老的符文名讳：坎特维特。
raw_zh.name: 斯奎特的罩衫

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Evade{/c} is now Sorcerer's {c_important}Teleport{/c} and costs {c_number}33{/c} Primary Resource.{/u}{/c}{/c}
raw_en.name: Enigma

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}闪避{/c}现在变为巫师的{c_important}传送术{/c}，并消耗 {c_number}33{/c} 点主要资源。{/u}{/c}{/c}
raw_zh.name: 谜团

implict: Indestructible
raw_en.name: Prudence

implict: 不可摧毁
raw_zh.name: 谨慎

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Attacks have up to a {c_random}[15 - 30]%{/c} chance to unleash a Rank {c_random}15{/c} Druid {c_important}Tornado{/c}.
{c_number}50%{/c} Chance to unleash a Rank {c_random}15{/c} Druid {c_important}Cyclone Armor{/c} whenever you Dodge.{/c}{/c}
raw_en.name: Rain

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}幸运一击:{/c} 攻击最多有 {c_random}[15 - 30]%{/c} 几率释放一个 {c_random}15{/c} 级德鲁伊{c_important}龙卷风{/c}。
每次闪避时有 {c_number}50%{/c} 几率释放一个 {c_random}15{/c} 级德鲁伊{c_important}旋风甲{/c}。{/c}{/c}
raw_zh.name: 暴雨

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}You are {c_important}Blood Lanced{/c}, and when {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} would deal damage to you, it instead {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}5%{/c} of your Maximum Life and has a {c_number}10%{/c} chance to form a {c_important}Blood Orb{/c}.

{c_important}Blood Lance{/c} deals {c_random}[70 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The Cathedral of Light's earliest attempts at crafting their penitent armor was to infuse the plate with painful blood magic, before such acts were deemed heretical." -Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Mutilator Plate

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你被{c_important}血矛贯穿{/c}，同时{c_important}血矛{/c}不再对你造成伤害，而是为你{c_important}{u}强固{/u}{/c} {c_number}5%{/c} 生命上限，且有 {c_number}10%{/c} 几率生成一个{c_important}生命球{/c}。

{c_important}血矛{/c}伤害提高 {c_random}[70 - 90]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “圣光大教堂在制作悔罪骑士铠甲时，最早尝试的方法是在铠甲板上注入痛苦的血魔法。但是后来，这种做法就成了歪门邪道。”——巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 肢解者板甲

affixesDesc: +[103.5 - 135.0]% Damage for 4 Seconds After Picking Up a Blood Orb
{c_unique}When you pick up {c_random}[3 - 10]{/c} {c_important}{u}Blood Orbs{/u}{/c}, a free {c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} is spawned, dealing bonus damage based on your current Life percent.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The infamous Necromancer Gaza-Thul's mastery over blood magic was indisputable. Many suspect that upon his death, his skin was used to fashion this eldritch armor." -Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Blood Artisan's Cuirass

affixesDesc: +[103.5 - 135.0]% 拾取生命球后 4 秒内的伤害
{c_unique}当你拾取 {c_random}[3 - 10]{/c} 个{c_important}{u}生命球{/u}{/c}时, 生成一个免费的{c_important}骨灵{/c}, 造成基于你当前生命值百分比的加成伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “臭名昭著的死灵法师加沙图尔对鲜血魔法的掌握水平毋庸置疑。许多人怀疑在他死后，他的皮肤被用于制作这件骇人的护甲。”——巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 鲜血匠师的胸甲

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} explodes an additional time, dealing {c_random}[35 - 45]%{/c} of normal damage. 

{c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} deals {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "There have been tales, though I cannot attest to their veracity, of Necromancers drawing power from their anger, from their belief that the world has shifted far out of Balance." -Deckard Cain
raw_en.name: Vengeful Sinew

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}骨灵{/c}会额外爆炸一次，造成 {c_random}[35 - 45]%{/c} 普通伤害。

{c_important}骨灵{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “有一些传说，虽然我无法证实其真实性，据说死灵法师能从他们的愤怒中、从他们认为世界已经远远偏离平衡的信念中汲取力量。”——迪卡德·凯恩
raw_zh.name: 复仇肌腱

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Juggernaut Oath{/c} makes your {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skills {c_number}25%{/c} larger but Consumes up to {c_number}16{/c} {u}{c_important}Resolve{/c}{/u}, granting {c_random}[4.0 - 6.0]%[x]{/c} increased {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skill damage for each point Consumed.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The ensign bears the words: 'Beneath Saint Lalszo the Grey's gentle gaze, the cruel laid down their wrath, and the meek rose as lions. By his grace, no lost soul shall tread alone.'
raw_en.name: Mantle of the Grey

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}主宰者誓约{/c}使你的{c_important}主宰者{/c}技能范围扩大 {c_number}25%{/c}，但最多消耗 {c_number}16{/c} 层{u}{c_important}决断{/c}{/u}，每消耗一层，使{c_important}主宰者{/c}技能伤害提高 {c_random}[4.0 - 6.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 旗帜上写着：“在‘灰者’圣拉尔斯佐的温柔凝视下，残酷者放下愤怒，温顺者奋起如狮。蒙他恩典，迷途的灵魂皆有同行者。”
raw_zh.name: 灰者披肩

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Trap{/c} Skills can be thrown and deal {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased damage. {/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Rumor has it he lost them in a game of Skull & Anchor, but the boss is a devil with the dice. I think he wanted to give the poor sod something to keep him warm without wounding his pride."
- Elstir
raw_en.name: Scoundrel's Leathers

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}陷阱{/c}技能可以被投掷到远处，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “有传言说这是他在一场头骨与锚的游戏中输掉的，对手是一名骰子高手。我认为他想给这个可怜的家伙一些保暖的东西，但又不想伤及他的自尊。” - 艾斯迪尔
raw_zh.name: 地痞的皮装

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Casting {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} makes you {c_important}{u}Immune{/u}{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds, but your {c_important}Evade{/c} Cooldown is increased by {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Evading{/c} while {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} is active leaves behind an explosion that deals {c_random}[450 - 600]{/c} Shadow damage and Pulls In enemies.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "In fairer times, the Emperor gifted Prince Aidan a gilded shroud. Still a boy, not yet full height, it dwarfed poor Aidan. Briefly, Leoric's growing madness abated from laughter." -Deckard Cain
raw_en.name: Shroud of Khanduras

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}施放{c_important}暗影帷幕{/c}会使你在 {c_number}2{/c} 秒内{c_important}{u}免疫{/u}{/c}所有伤害。但是，你的{c_important}闪避{/c}的冷却时间增加 {c_number}3{/c} 秒。

在{c_important}暗影帷幕{/c}生效期间{c_important}闪避{/c}会引发一次爆炸，造成 {c_random}[450 - 600]{/c} 点暗影伤害并拉拽敌人。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “很久以前，李奥瑞克王曾赐给艾丹王子一件镀金的裹衣。彼时，王子尚且年幼，个子还不高，穿上这件衣服之后显得更加矮小。然后，李奥瑞克日益增长的疯狂便在开怀敞笑中有所消减。”——迪卡德·凯恩
raw_zh.name: 堪杜拉斯之衣

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Teleport{/c} pulls Close enemies to you and you gain {c_random}[40 - 50]{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}8{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The power you have is never enough.
raw_en.name: Raiment of the Infinite

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}传送术{/c}会将近距敌人拉向你，并且你获得 {c_random}[40 - 50]{/c} 伤害减免，持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 你拥有的力量永远不够。
raw_zh.name: 无限法衣

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Blizzard's{/c} effects linger on enemies for an additional {c_random}[100 - 120]%{/c} of its duration.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The Firstborn sorrow is not forgotten, but sleeps in the sea, and in time wakes again.
raw_en.name: Raiment of the Sea

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}暴风雪{/c}的效果会在敌人身上额外残留其持续时间的 {c_random}[100 - 120]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 初诞者的悲伤并未被遗忘，而是在海中沉睡，并终将再次苏醒。
raw_zh.name: 苍海法衣

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Spending Vigor Heals you for {c_random}[7 - 10]%{/c} of your Maximum Life. 

Every second, your active Cooldowns each drain {c_number}10%{/c} Maximum Life from you to reduce their durations by {c_number}2{/c} seconds. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: This ceremonial armor was once adorned during the He Sutsar Puchē, where sacred blood is drawn by jacinth lancets and offered to flames. It retains the scents of incensed smoke and scorched copper.
raw_en.name: Jacinth Shell

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}消耗精力会为你恢复 {c_random}[7 - 10]%{/c} 的生命上限。

每秒，你的每个正在冷却的主动技能会吸取你 {c_number}10%{/c} 的生命上限，以使其持续时间减少 {c_number}2{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这种仪式盔甲曾在赫苏萨尔普切中被佩戴过，在仪式中，祭司用红锆石小刀引出圣血并献给火焰。盔甲上仍然留有焚香烟雾和烧焦的铜的气味。
raw_zh.name: 红锆石胄衣

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Sigil{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[70 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage. Active {c_important}Sigils{/c} gain {c_number}1{/c} kill every second and unused kills are saved when they expire.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "...Our rites are written not with ink, but with blood. Not upon stone, but upon the living flesh..." -Taphya 13:6
raw_en.name: Fleshwrit Carapace

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}符印{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[70 - 90]%[x]{/c}。激活的{c_important}符印{/c}每秒获得 {c_number}1{/c} 个击杀数，未使用的击杀数将在符印失效时保留。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “……我们的仪祭绝非以墨水书写，而是以鲜血浇灌；绝非铭刻于顽石，而是烙印在活人的血肉之上……”——《塔菲亚》13:6
raw_zh.name: 血肉铭文甲壳

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Ae'grom{/c} and its summons deal {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c} increased damage. You additionally summon {c_important}Ae'grom's{/c} other half and gain a second Charge of {c_important}Command Ae'grom{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Cut a demon nice and wide. Something rises from inside. Eye and fang, bone and sinew. What was one has become two." -Ravings of a mad Vizjerei
raw_en.name: Ae'grom's Schism

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}艾格罗姆{/c}及其仆从造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c}。你会额外召唤{c_important}艾格罗姆{/c}的另一半，并额外获得一层{c_important}命令艾格罗姆{/c}充能。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “把恶魔切开，切得又大又宽，里头就会有东西钻出来——眼珠、尖牙、碎骨、烂筋。本来只有一只的，现在变成了两只。”——疯狂维兹杰雷的胡言乱语
raw_zh.name: 艾格罗姆之裂

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Basic{/c} and {c_important}Core{/c} Skills that use this weapon now {c_important}{b}{u}Reload{/u}{/b}{/c}.
{c_important}{b}{u}Reload{/u}{/b}{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage and every second {c_important}{b}{u}Reload{/u}{/b}{/c} Skill increases this bonus by {c_number}100%[x]{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: This crossbow is marred by a hundred battles. Mercy is its stranger. When its quarrel flies, a generation weeps.
raw_en.name: Orphan Maker

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}使用该武器的{c_important}基础{/c}和{c_important}核心{/c}技能时会进行{c_important}{b}{u}装填{/u}{/b}{/c}。
{c_important}{b}{u}装填{/u}{/b}{/c}技能的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}，每第二次施放{c_important}{b}{u}装填{/u}{/b}{/c}技能使加成提高 {c_number}100%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}2{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这把弩印刻着百战的伤痕，它不知道仁慈为何物。箭矢离弦之时，一整代的儿童放声哭泣。
raw_zh.name: 孤儿制造者

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal [2,200 - 5,400] Poisoning Damage over 10 seconds
implict: +15.0% Chance for an extra item from the Purveyor of Curiosities
raw_en.name: Edge

affixesDesc: 幸运一击: 最多有 40% 几率在 10 秒内造成 [2,200 - 5,400] 点中毒伤害
implict: +15.0% 几率从珍品商处额外获得一件物品
raw_zh.name: 锐锋

x[45 - 55]% Physical Damage Multiplier

raw_en.name: Infinity

x[45 - 55]% 毒素 伤害增倍
x[45 - 55]% 物理 伤害增倍

implict: 幸运一击: 最多有 40.0% 几率造成粉碎一击
raw_zh.name: 无限

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal +[3,000 - 4,800] Lightning Damage
raw_en.name: Zephyr

affixesDesc: 幸运一击：最多有 40% 几率造成 +[3,000 - 4,800] 点闪电伤害
raw_zh.name: 和风

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}When consuming a Corpse, there is a {c_random}[40 - 50]%{/c} chance to also create a decaying {c_important}Skeletal Simulacrum{/c} that seeks enemies but cannot attack. When it dies, it explodes for {c_number}450{/c} Shadow damage. 

This effect is treated as a {c_important}Macabre{/c} Skill.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Nearby corpses shudder in its presence.
raw_en.name: The Mortacrux

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}消耗一具亡骸后，有 {c_random}[40 - 50]%{/c} 几率同时生成一个腐朽的{c_important}骷髅幻影{/c}，它会寻找敌人，但无法攻击。它死亡时爆炸，造成 {c_number}450{/c} 点暗影伤害。

此效果被视为一个{c_important}骇术{/c}技能。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 一对匕首中的一把，两把刀永世不得相见。附近的亡骸因这把匕首而战栗。
raw_zh.name: 死亡匕首

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}5{/c} seconds when Consuming {c_number}3{/c} {c_important}Combo Points{/c}. Casting {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills always generates {c_number}3{/c} {c_important}Combo Points{/c}.

Generating {c_important}Combo Points{/c} allows you to generate the same amount of {c_important}Combo Points{/c} for {c_number}1.5{/c} seconds when you spend them.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"I've never seen such ruthless butchery. He deserves to be shipped off to die in the swamps with the rest of the godless murderers."
- Witness to the murder of Sergeant Walcot
raw_en.name: Condemnation

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}消耗 {c_number}3{/c} 个{c_important}连击点数{/c}后，你的{c_important}核心{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒。施放{c_important}基础{/c}技能必定生成 {c_number}3{/c} 个{c_important}连击点数{/c}。

生成{c_important}连击点数{/c}后，在接下来的 {c_number}1.5{/c} 秒内消耗这些点数时，会生成等量的{c_important}连击点数{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“我从未见过如此残忍的屠杀。他活该被流放，就该与其他不信神的杀人犯一起死在沼泽地里。”
——沃尔科特军士被谋杀时的目击证人
raw_zh.name: 定罪

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Hits with this weapon increase your Attack Speed by {c_random}[3.5 - 5.0]%[+]{/c} and damage by {c_random}[11.7 - 16.7]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[10.5 - 15.0]%[+]{/c} and {c_random}[35.0 - 50.0]%[x]{/c} respectively.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: When Caldeum's gates closed, Asheara led her Iron Wolves out of the city knowing full well they would never return. Instead they roamed Kehjistan pledging their blades to any who were in need.
raw_en.name: Asheara's Khanjar

affixesDesc: {c_unique}使用该武器命中会使你的攻击速度提高 {c_random}[3.5 - 5.0]%[+]{/c}，伤害提高 {c_random}[11.7 - 16.7]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}4{/c} 秒，最高分别可达 {c_random}[10.5 - 15.0]%[+]{/c} 和 {c_random}[35.0 - 50.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 当卡尔蒂姆的城门关闭时，艾席拉带着她的铁狼离开了这座城市，她深知他们再也回不来了。他们在凯基斯坦漫游，用刀刃帮助任何有需要的人。
raw_zh.name: 艾席拉的弯刀

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Dealing {c_number}2{/c} different types of Non-Physical damage increases the Potency of your {c_important}Imbuement{/c} Skills by {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} and Non-Physical damage by {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}8{/c} seconds. 

{c_important}Basic{/c} Skills are now {c_important}Imbueable{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Prepare thoroughly before approaching any warlock. Fill your elixirs, replenish your arrows. Oil and sheath your blades before you depart." -Arts of the Viz-Jaq'taar
raw_en.name: Etna's Lost Dagger

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}造成 {c_number}2{/c} 种不同类型的非物理伤害会使你{c_important}灌注{/c}技能的强度提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}，非物理伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒。

{c_important}基础{/c}技能现在{c_important}可灌注{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “在接近任何术士之前必须做好充分的准备。装满你的药剂，补充你的箭矢。在出发前为你的刀刃上油并收入鞘中。”——《维兹贾塔的技艺》
raw_zh.name: 埃特娜的失落匕首

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Twisting Blades{/c} impales an extra set of blades into its target, dealing {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased damage and creating additional blades that return to you.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "I am a symphony of blades at your disposal. No need to get your hands dirty, I will deal with any blood or body work. So, how much gold do you have?" -Mouse, Assassin for Hire
raw_en.name: The Maestro

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}回旋刀锋{/c}会向目标刺入额外一组剑刃，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}，并生成额外向你飞回的剑刃。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我是任您差遣的刀刃交响曲。不需要脏了您的手，我会处理任何沾血或与尸骨有关的活计。那么，您有多少金币？”——雇佣刺客，老鼠
raw_zh.name: 艺术大师

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skills create an attackable {c_important}Shade Totem{/c} for {c_random}[6.0 - 8.0]{/c} seconds. Any damage it takes is replicated onto surrounding enemies at {c_number}50%{/c} effectiveness. 

This effect is treated as a {c_important}Trap{/c} Skill. You may only have {c_number}1{/c} {c_important}Shade Totem{/c} active at a time.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Bitter voices whisper from the blade.
raw_en.name: The Umbracrux

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}诡诈{/c}技能会制造出一个可攻击的{c_important}阴影图腾{/c}，持续 {c_random}[6.0 - 8.0]{/c} 秒。它受到的任何伤害都会以 {c_number}50%{/c} 的效果复制给周围的敌人。

此效果被视作{c_important}陷阱{/c}技能。你同一时间最多只能激活 {c_number}1{/c} 个{c_important}阴影图腾{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 一对匕首中的一把，两把刀永世不得相见。刀刃上传来了尖酸的低语。
raw_zh.name: 暗影匕首

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Inferno{/c} constricts the area {c_number}2{/c} more times and deals {c_random}[20 - 25]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The venom from these fangs was known to cause severe blisters and burns - forever. The Zann Esu were known to use them to fashion blades, supplementing their own abilities.
raw_en.name: Fang of the Vipermagi

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}炼狱烈焰{/c}会将范围额外收缩 {c_number}2{/c} 次，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[20 - 25]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 众所周知，这些毒牙中的毒液会导致严重的起泡和烧伤——而且是永久性的。据说赞·艾苏经常用它们来打造刀刃，以此来补充她们自身的能力。
raw_zh.name: 蝮蛇法妖之牙

raw_en.flavor: This blade favors the unguarded, the unmourned, the straggler.  For it knows that all bonds weaken in time, and that even kings may be found unguarded if patience is infinite.
raw_en.name: Rustbitten Dirk

affixesDesc: {c_unique}对落单的敌人造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[90 - 120]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 游侠, 死灵法师, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 此刃垂青无备之人、无主之魂，或是掉队的落单者。因为它深知，情义羁绊终会随时光磨灭；而只要有无穷的耐心，纵使君王也会露出破绽。
raw_zh.name: 锈斑短匕
